purpose: Determine whether one sufficiently supported station-quarter label window remains genuinely unexposed to P1 model, threshold, gate, or candidate-outcome selection. This audit cannot choose, fit, score, rescue, or promote a candidate.

freshness_definition_sealed_before_inven.unit: complete KST calendar quarter intersected with the distributed train chronology
requirements: the complete candidate evaluation quarter is strictly after a nonempty causal model-fit and selection prefix
no label in the quarter has previously informed architecture, feature, model, checkpoint, threshold, gate, candidate comparison, or audit outcome
the quarter contains observations from at least two distinct stations and at least two supported station-layer identities
the window can be opened once without reusing a Q2, Q3, Q4, inner-validation, or calibration truth surface
freshness_definition_sealed_before_inven.reason: Carving a new cell, month, or residual week from an already inspected quarter would make freshness depend on the accumulated research history and would not provide an independent transport outcome.

station_quarter_inventory.reason: single-station support and no earlier distributed train prefix
single-station support; this period is part of historical fitting prefixes
single-station support and Jul-Aug labels were an inner structure-selection window
single-station support and Oct-Nov labels were an inner structure-selection window
Jan-Feb labels were an inner structure-selection window; the quarter is also the canonical pre-Q2 fit/calibration surface
canonical outer selection and repeated candidate/audit outcome surface
canonical outer confirmation and repeated candidate outcome surface
canonical outer performance and repeated candidate outcome surface

q2_q3_q4_metrics_and_predictions.evidence: metrics and prediction parts exist for all three 2025 outer quarters and five learning-curve fractions

global_exposure_receipt.evidence: explicitly records that Q3/Q4 historical truth surfaces were already globally exposed

prior_research_ledger.evidence: explicitly classifies P1 Q2/Q3/Q4 as hypothesis-exposed surfaces

v33_bundle_registry.meaning: These label-blind Q2 bundles improve later auditability but do not create a fresh labeled window. v35 and v52 subsequently opened two distinct fixed Q2 masks on the same Q2 truth surface.

decision.reason: All multi-station quarters are already exposed; all earlier quarters have only one station, and the earliest quarters cannot be later-than-fit causal transport windows. No existing label can be relabeled as fresh by changing cells or gates.
decision.minimum_new_evidence: A newly acquired, competition-allowed labeled chronological block strictly after 2025-12-10, covering at least two stations and two supported station-layer identities, whose labels remain sealed until one fully preregistered candidate, threshold, and action budget are frozen. Alternatively, an organizer-designated never-opened labeled holdout with an authenticated exposure ledger would suffice.
